text:
noah.r: Hey all, first morning here. I clicked the Okta invite but it opened while I was signed into my personal Google and created a link to my gmail alias. Can you resend to noah.r@redwood.com?

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Noah! :wave: Sending to noah.r@redwood.com now and revoking the other invite. Watch spam/promotions.

okta-bot: Previous invite revoked for noah.r+alias@gmail.com. New invite sent to noah.r@redwood.com (expires in 24h).

noah.r: Got the company invite and started enroll, but the browser autofilled a passkey from my personal Apple ID and Okta rejected it with "authenticator not allowed". Don't want my personal ID tied to work.

sam-it: Hi Noah 1 Totally get it. Quick workaround: accept the invite in an incognito/private window so autofill doesn't pick your personal Apple passkey. Alternatively pick "Set up different authenticator" -> "Authenticator app (TOTP)" to use 1Password/Authy as backup.

noah.r: Incognito avoided the personal passkey but Safari still offered my iCloud passkey. I cancelled and tried to register a new one but Okta failed with "attestation mismatch."

sam-it: Attestation mismatches can happen when the platform authenticator returns a format our policy doesn't accept. Two options: 1) register TOTP in 1Password now and finish onboarding, then register a company-bound passkey from a newer device; 2) if you have a hardware key (YubiKey), choose "Security Key" in the flow. If neither works I can force a session sync from the admin console.

olivia-peopleops: FYI 1Password provisioning is automatic after Okta shows you as ACTIVE. If it doesn't arrive in ~10m reply here and I'll do a manual SCIM provision.

noah.r: I set up TOTP in 1Password and Okta shows MFA enrolled, but I don't see the 1Password invite email yet.

1password-bot: 1Password: Invitation will be delivered after SCIM provisioning completes. Status: queued.

sam-it: I forced a SCIM sync and re-applied group memberships. You should get the 1Password invite and Drive shares shortly. Let me know if the invite bounces.

noah.r: Invite arrived! Set up 1Password and created a company passkey on my laptop (cleared the personal one). All good now. Thanks for the quick help.

olivia-peopleops: Awesome, welcome aboard Noah! If anyone else runs into autofill/passkey crossover during enrollment, ping #new-hires or DM me and we can toggle per-user enrollment policy. :tada:
